items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: we had Stanley Clarke on bass and Airto was playing drums

ctx.x: I’m about to wrap up here, but when I look at the recordings of that time, Pharoah Sanders’ time and into the 70s, it doesn’t look like there was a lot of white musicians, if any, that sort of participated in that style of music. In fact I think you had Joe Beck in your first group?

Oh yeah, well Bob — Bob wanted Joe in because Joe did some recordings. Because I remember the record, oh shoot, that’s another story. When Gato — we were on the road one time, we had Stanley Clarke on bass and Airto was playing drums. So we were in Philadelphia and the last night of the engagement in Philadelphia Stanley and Airto told Gato, he said, “Well we’ll see you — we’re getting ready to go to California.” So we said what’s happening? They were going to California to form their group Return to Forever with…
